latest_features: Adds the new admin-only SchemBuild module that loads the latest .schem or .schematic from the AutoBuild folder and renders it in-world as movable ghost blocks anchored to a nearby armor stand
SchemBuild supports configurable ghost opacity plus layer-up and layer-down keybinds so you can step through one horizontal layer at a time or return to a full-build preview
Access control now uses three effective module tiers: public, whitelist, and admin, so admin-only modules no longer leak through the old merged vip/admin policy path
The client still accepts legacy policy keys like normal and vip as compatibility aliases, but the checked-in policy now emits only public, whitelist, and admin
